## Publication change

Describe the public route, editorial record, or production control affected by this change.

## Release evidence

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] English/Lithuanian parity was reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Material factual or assessment changes include a visible dated revision note.
- [ ] New public evidence has provenance and redistribution rights have been considered.
- [ ] No credentials, private victim data, active payloads, unpublished cases, or source-media originals are included.
- [ ] Sensitive security material was reported privately instead of being attached here.
